mentions.name: Cakedesk
mentions.description: This is a fast and simple invoicing app for small businesses, available on Windows and Mac. Users can create their own PDF invoice templates with HTML/CSS, and it is sold as a one-time purchase rather than a subscription. An Obsidian-style cloud sync feature is under consideration because it is frequently requested.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Cakedesk: Fast & simple invoicing app for small businesses (Windows & Mac).

Been working on this for about 4 years. It has some cool features, like letting you create your own PDF templates with HTML/CSS. Most users love that it's so simple and just a one-time purchase.
